name: rating
title: Rating
description: Pick or show a score from 1 to a maximum, as stars.
a11y: Editable: a radio group (native radios) with arrow-key selection; each star is named "N of M".
Read-only: role="img" with a text label such as "4 out of 5".

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the control, for example "Rate this article".

props.name: value
props.description: The current score (0 to `max`) when controlled. Pair with `onValueChange`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial score when uncontrolled. Default 0.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new score (1 to `max`) when the user picks a star.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Shows the score without letting anyone change it.

props.name: name
props.description: Name of the underlying radio inputs, so the score submits with a native form. A unique name is generated if omitted.

usage:
import {Rating} from '@monoline/react';

<Rating aria-label="Rate this page" defaultValue={3} />
